rows.en: ...Isn't there something you ought to tell me?

Where's this coming from all of a sudden...?
Something to tell you...? Not really... I think?
Probably...
Um... I have no idea what's going on...

I've been hearing some nasty rumors...
Word is you've been hanging out with that girl
a lot lately...?
rows.notes: Ano onna = 'that woman/girl'; the person is not named in the scene (the scene is generic, reused with 'that guy' in c00272).

rows.en: Huh? Rumors? What are you talking about?

Don't turn out like Michel, okay?
Learn a little self-restraint.

What's this all of a sudden...?
Something to tell you...? Not really... I think?
Probably...
rows.notes: Also used by the male player in ext_luk scenes; kept neutral.

rows.en: I don't care who you hang out with, but...
You'd better watch your back, y'know?
rows.notes: Sono senaka ki wo tsuketa hou ga ii = watch your back.

rows.en: Let's hurry and go change, Alto.
Yeah... I'm all sticky with sweat.
What do they want at the locker room...?

A thief?
I hope my wallet's okay...

Oh, that's fine.
Looks like the culprit was only after uniforms.

Uniforms?!
This is the boys' locker room!
rows.notes: Also used in the female version of the scene; the line still reads (the player is pointing at the room).

rows.en: That's why people are saying the culprit's a girl.

Well, there are a lot of good-looking guys here,
but still...
Why do I have to wear this getup?!
rows.notes: Alto is in a Culture Fest costume (c00254); the costume is not described.

rows.en:
Good thing the one from the Culture Fest
was still around, huh?
You don't want to wear your gym clothes, right?
I would've, if we hadn't just had gym...
rows.notes: The gym clothes are sweaty now.

rows.en: Well... it looks really good on you, though.

It's lunchtime, so it'd be great if you poured me
some tea in that outfit.

Gotta hurry and change!
No peeking, okay?!
What do they want at the locker room?

A thief?
Is my wallet okay...?

I've been hearing some nasty rumors...
Word is you've been hanging out with that guy
a lot lately...?
rows.notes: ext_alt_007: same scene with ano otoko.

rows.en: What should I have for dinner~?

No one's there...
I could've sworn I sensed something...

I've got chills down my spine...
Did I catch a cold...?
It feels like someone's following me...

rows.notes: Japanese reads 'sassato kaette neeyoo'; taken as a slurred 'kaette neyou' (go home and sleep), which fits the cold in c00283.

rows.en: Hmph... Guess I'll turn it in at the police box...
rows.notes: The stranger (Brera) has the player's wallet; 'it' = the wallet.

rows.en: I'll find out who it is at the next corner!!
Th-there's no way I'm all right...
rows.notes: Player is polite (desu) to the stranger.

rows.en: My body moved before I could think. I'm sorry...

...Um, you've been following me around,
haven't you...?

uncertain: c00228: 'that girl' for ano onna, person unnamed in the scene.
c00284: odd kana 'kaette neeyoo' read as 'go home and sleep'.
